```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

## Length and starting nucleotide

### Ahya 

Read in data 
```{r}
# Set directory and read all ahya files at once
path <- "~/Desktop/BarottLab/Cnidarian_sperm_smRNA/length_distribution/ahya/trimmomatic/"
file_list <- list.files(path, pattern = "*length_start.txt", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine all files, adding sample identifier
all_data_ahya <- file_list %>%
  lapply(function(f) {
    read.table(f,
               header = FALSE,
               col.names = c("length", "start_nt"),
               sep = "",
               colClasses = c("integer", "character"))
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

Calculate % of total reads 
```{r}
summary_data_ahya <- all_data_ahya %>%
  filter(length <= 35) %>%
  count(length, start_nt) %>%
  mutate(percent_total = n / sum(n) * 100)
```

Change T to U 
```{r}
summary_data_ahya$start_nt <- sub("T", "U", summary_data_ahya$start_nt)
```

Plot!
```{r}
ggplot(summary_data_ahya, aes(x = factor(length), y = percent_total, fill = start_nt)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Read length",
       y = "% of total reads", 
       title = "Acropora hyacinthus") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("A" = "green3",
                               "C" = "goldenrod1",
                               "G" = "dodgerblue",
                               "U" = "red2")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
